welcome.title: Welcome to Stereonet Explorer
welcome.body: Use the navigation bar to switch between classroom and analysis views. This tour walks through the core workflow that works offline in the field.

input.title: Add planes and lines
input.body: Start on the left panel to add structural measurements. Enter dip direction and dip for planes or trend and plunge for lines—the data persists automatically.

canvas.title: Interpret the stereonet
canvas.body: The toolbar lets you toggle projections, grid overlays and sample data. Orientations appear on the central stereonet using D3 so you can inspect poles and great circles.

data.title: Review and prepare datasets
data.body: The table on the right lists every orientation stored locally (Dexie). Use it to clean up entries, export results, or prepare for upcoming map and layer tools.
